subject: Request for documents in connection with the appeal filed against Order-in-Original No. 09/2026-GST dated 12.05.2026 - reg.
body_paragraphs: Please refer to your letter cited above regarding the appeal filed by you against the Order-in-Original No. 09/2026-GST dated 12.05.2026.

body_paragraphs.text: In order to furnish the department's comments to the Appellate Authority, you are requested to furnish the following documents:
points: Copy of the appeal in FORM GST APL-01 along with acknowledgement in FORM GST APL-02
Proof of payment of pre-deposit under Section 107(6) of the CGST Act, 2017

body_paragraphs: The above documents may be furnished within 15 days from the date of receipt of this letter.
